name: Face Culling
definition: A mesh generation optimization that reduces the number of vertices sent to the GPU by skipping the rendering of voxel faces that are adjacent to existing neighboring voxels. It solves the problem of naively rendering all 6 faces of every cube, including those hidden by neighbors.
summary: Face Culling is a mesh optimization that skips rendering voxel faces adjacent to neighbors, distinguished by its direct per-voxel neighbor lookup during creation rather than post-generation filtering.
